notes.title: The Storyteller's Festival
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/TwoHalfStudios/sale/TheStorytellersFestival2025]The Storyteller's Festival[/url] is happening now! This is a week-long Steam festival focused on visual novels and other story-driven games. There's over 400 games in the event—including a few of ours!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44819009/1797ae3b598bd8cbb322e0b3f7bbf305213200f4.png[/img]

Here's a few of our other LGBT+ yuri titles that are in the festival—give them a wishlist or check out their demos if you'd like to support us!

[b]A Tithe in Blood[/b] is a dark yuri romance story about modern magic mixing with old mysteries.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2989270/A_Tithe_in_Blood/

[b]Lock & Key: A Magical Girl Mystery[/b] is a mystery yuri visual novel about magical girls solving one last crime before their powers go away for good.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1803850/Lock__Key_A_Magical_Girl_Mystery/

[b]Our Home, My Keeper[/b] is a slice-of-life yuri romance about a burnt out writer and a fairy who might just help her out.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3092190/Our_Home_My_Keeper/

[b]Please Be Happy[/b] is a comfy slice-of-life yuri romance about a traveling foxgirl and the pair of women she meets one fateful day in Wellington.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/844670/Please_Be_Happy/

[b]Twofold[/b] is an LGBT+ romance about a struggling nonbinary college student and the women who help them pass—but need help of their own.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1749770/Twofold/

We're also teaming up with several other visual novel developers to share the wide world of visual novels in the festival!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44819009/97a6c17c3fd2b7a5b531d14d75a9f8595ea608dc.png[/img]

notes.title: Demo available now!
notes.content:
The demo for Summer at the Edge of the Universe, our next LGBT+ yuri visual novel, is now playable!

Follow Summer Nansen as she travels on one last journey across the universe with her friends before they each go their separate ways.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44819009/dd6255739d988528c661317357eae0332c3bcf41.png[/img]

This demo should take around 2-4 hours to complete and has English voice acting! There's also a survey at the end of the demo for you to fill out with feedback.

Samayuni has been in development for several years now and we hope you enjoy this slice of the game!
